steps.name: Step 1 — Create three credentials with distinct/overlapping-prefix names
Step 2 — Navigate to /credentials/all: page loads, search box present and empty
Step 3 — Type 'alpha' and press Enter: only autotest_cred_alpha is displayed
Step 4 — Clear and type 'autotest_cred': all three seeded credentials shown, unrelated pre-existing credentials excluded
Step 5 — Clear and type 'nonexistent_xyz': empty state renders, total=0

Step 6 — Click the search box's Clear (X) icon after the zero-results search: the full list should be restored and the URL should stay /credentials/all (Known defect: #551 — redirects to /credentials/create-credential instead)
Control check (Axis 2) — clearing after a NON-empty-result search restores the list correctly (defect #551 is scoped to the zero-results path only)
Side-channel check — no console errors/warnings across the flow
Cleanup — delete the three seeded credentials
